status: COMPLETE sharp logarithmic free reciprocal lattice sum, actual source half-denominator symbols and actual full physical L2/continuous half-denominator maps with exact original Fourier coefficients and norm bounds. Weighted perturbation estimate, native perturbed factorization and periodic projection convergence remain OPEN.
results: A reusable variable-power reciprocal-product bound gives n^(-a) decay for every 0<=a<1 with an explicit constant 4*(2-a)/(1-a). Optimizing at a=1-1/log(n) proves the SHARP logarithmic-over-index bound for the unweighted Hill kernel, without using a divergent full harmonic lattice as a summable majorant.

On the ENTIRE LITERAL original source circle |z-(pi*n)^2|=n, EVERY free denominator |z-pi^2*k^2| is at least n. The FULL reciprocal lattice sum is summable and at most (8*exp(1)+2)*log(n)/n whenever log(n)>1. BOTH ORIGINAL resonant modes k=+n and k=-n are explicitly retained, with their original reciprocal 1/n contributions.

The ACTUAL raw half-denominator 1/sqrt(|z-pi^2*k^2|) is realized as a square-summable Fourier symbol with EVERY original coefficient retained. Its norm squared is EXACTLY the FULL reciprocal lattice sum and therefore has the sharp (8*exp(1)+2)*log(n)/n bound. No complex square-root branch or reduced-mode substitute is used.

The SAME raw half-denominator is also a bounded Fourier symbol with exact supremum bound 1/sqrt(n) on the ENTIRE source circle. The l2 and l-infinity symbol constructions agree with the SAME original raw coefficients on all source-circle parameters.

The source D_lambda^(-1/2) is CONSTRUCTED on ALL original periodic physical L2 inputs with both actual continuous physical outputs and actual source-normalized L2 outputs. Their original Fourier coefficients are the literal half-denominator products. The uniform-output operator norm squared is at most (8*exp(1)+2)*log(n)/n; the L2 operator norm is at most 1/sqrt(n) with exact constant ONE.

The ACTUAL continuous and L2 half-denominator outputs have EXACTLY the SAME physical L2 class, under the original period-two probability normalization. Thus the continuous-output estimate applies to the same original physical function in the Appendix C.4 factorization. These are the FREE half-denominator factors; no bound for the perturbed S_lambda or for the actual projection difference is claimed yet.
essential_remaining: Construct the ACTUAL normalized perturbation S_lambda(k,j)=q_(k-j)/(sqrt(|lambda-pi^2*k^2|)*sqrt(|lambda-pi^2*j^2|)) on the full source periodic physical L2 space. Prove its weighted H^t-to-operator estimate for -1<t<-1/2 with sharp high-energy decay, retaining the SAME original potential distribution.

Prove the ACTUAL full native resolvent factorization through the normalized phase diagonal I_lambda, the actual inverse (I_lambda-S_lambda)^(-1) and the NEW constructed half-denominator factors. Obtain the actual periodic contour projection difference estimate with locally uniform original source thresholds. The NEW free-factor estimates alone do NOT prove periodic projection convergence or the full C.4 rate.

Use the resulting periodic projection bound to prove source 2.14, the quantitative eta bound in 2.13 and source overlap (32)/2.15. The full canonical periodic eta identity, actual source circles/rank TWO/orthonormal basis and whole-range improved endpoint regularity are already PROVED. Complete full periodic-to-Dirichlet residual (31), precise C.4 Dirichlet rate and full COMPLEX weighted midpoint Theorem 2.1(ii).
Complete remaining original Birkhoff-map and actual KdV approximation-flow constructions for MAIN theorems 1.1, 1.3, 1.4, 5.1 and 5.9. All five remain UNPROVED; goal ACTIVE.

source_correspondence.circle: ENTIRE LITERAL original circle |z-(pi*n)^2|=n; n is the ORIGINAL positive mode index. All Fourier modes k in Z, INCLUDING BOTH resonant modes, are retained.
source_correspondence.denominator: Original period-two free energy pi^2*k^2 with its exact original normalization. Denominator modulus is at least n everywhere on the source circle.
source_correspondence.logarithmic_sum: The FULL sum over ALL original signed modes of 1/|z-pi^2*k^2| is at most (8*exp(1)+2)*log(n)/n, for n>=1 and log(n)>1.
source_correspondence.half_symbol: The ACTUAL nonnegative raw symbol 1/sqrt(|z-pi^2*k^2|), not an analytic square-root branch. Its l2 norm squared is EXACTLY the full reciprocal sum and its infinity norm is at most 1/sqrt(n).
source_correspondence.physical_domain: ALL source periodic CircleL2 inputs. Probability Haar measure gives the EXACT source half-integral normalization on [0,2]; no physical period-one restriction is imposed on input functions.
source_correspondence.physical_output: Actual C(AddCircle 2,C) uniform-output and source-normalized physical L2 maps. Their outputs are EXACTLY the same original L2 class; uniform-output operator norm squared <= (8*exp(1)+2)*log(n)/n, and L2 operator norm <=1/sqrt(n).
source_correspondence.quantifiers: Every original source-circle point and every physical L2 input; constants are absolute and independent of the potential. This is the FREE-factor step of C.4, not yet a theorem about perturbed potentials or projection differences.
source_correspondence.not_claimed: No actual S_lambda norm estimate, normalized perturbed inverse/factorization, periodic projection convergence, full C.4 logarithmic rate, quantitative 2.13 eta bound, free-mode 2.14 or main-theorem completion is claimed.
